questions.question: The LCM of two positive numbers is three times their HCF. If the product of the LCM and the HCF is 867, find the numbers.
questions.solution:
Given:

LCM = 3 × HCF

Concept used: 

If a and b are two numbers, then a × b = HCF × LCM

Calculations:

Let the numbers and HCF be a, b and y respectively.

a × b = HCF × LCM

⇒ a × b = y × 3y

⇒ ab = 3y2

HCF × LCM = 867

⇒ y × 3y = 867

⇒ 3y² = 867

⇒ y² = 867/3

⇒ y² = 289

⇒ y = 17

As we have given,

LCM = 3 × 17 = 51

So, 

a × b = 17 × 51

As the only possible pair of numbers is 17 and 51 according to the given condition,

we can say,

a = 17 and b = 51.

∴ The numbers are 17 and 51.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

The question can be solved by just checking the condition from the options.

From option 1, we can see that LCM of 17 and 51 is 51 and HCF is 17.

Which is satisfying the condition that LCM = 3 × HCF.

Also, 17 × 51 = 867.

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: A tank has two pipes. Pipe M is for filling the tank and pipe N is for emptying the tank. If pipe M takes 45 hours to completely fill the tank and pipe N takes 90 hours to empty the fully filled tank, then how many hours will they take to together fill the half empty tank completely?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken to fill a completely empty tank by pipe M = 45 hours

Time taken to empty a completely filled tank by pipe N = 90 hours

**Concept Used:**

If a pipe takes M hours to fill a completely empty tank, then the part of the tank filled by the pipe in 1 hour = 1/M

Similarly, if a pipe takes N hours to empty a completely empty tank, then the part of the tank emptied by the pipe in 1 hour = 1/N

But, the work done is negative while emptying the tank

**Calculation:**

Using the given conditions along with the concept used, we get:

Part of the tank filled by the pipe M in 1 hour = 1/45

Part of the tank emptied by the pipe N in 1 hour = 1/90

So, when both these tanks work together, the part of the tank they fill in one hour is obtained as:

1/45 – 1/90 = 1/90

Hence, the time taken by both the pipes to together fill the tank is obtained as:

1/(1/90) = 90 hours

Also, the time taken to fill the half empty tank completely, is obtained as:

90/2 = 45 hours 

**∴ The time the two pipes take to together fill the half empty tank completely is 45 hours**

questions.question: Which of the following procedures would you use to separate ammonium chloride from sodium chloride?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sublimation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sublimation** is the **conversion between the solid** and **the gaseous phases of matter, with no intermediate liquid stage**.

 
 
• Example: **Snow and ice changing into water vapor in the air without first melting into water**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
 

 **Distillation**
 
 __
 
• Distillation is a procedure by which two mixed liquids with different boiling points can be separated.
 
 
• It is an important separation process in chemistry, industry, and food science.
 
 
 
• Distillation involves boiling a liquid, then condensing the gas and collecting the liquid elsewhere.
 
• A liquid is boiled in the "distilling flask", then the vapors travel to another section of the apparatus where they come into contact with a cool surface.
 
 
 
 

 **Crystallization**
 
 
 
• It is a process by which a chemical is converted from a liquid solution into a solid crystalline state.
 
• Crystallization acts as both separation and purification steps.
 
• The crystallization process consists of two major events:
 
 
• Nucleation.
 
• Crystal Growth.
 
 
 
 
 
 

 **Filtration**
 
 
 
• Filtration is the process of separating suspended solid matter from a liquid.
 
• The liquid which has passed through the filter is called the filtrate. The filter may be paper, cloth, cotton-wool, asbestos, slag- or glass-wool, unglazed earthenware, sand, or other porous material.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question: The difference between 33% loss and 7% profit on selling an item is Rs 220. What is the cost price of the item?

**Given:**

The difference between 33% loss and 7% profit on selling an item is Rs 220.

**Formulae Used:**

If the Cost Price of an item is CP. 

Then, when the article is sold for a loss, the Selling Price (SP) of the article is obtained as:

SP = [(100 – %Loss)/100] × CP ----(i)

Similarly, when the article is sold for a profit, the Selling Price (SP) of the article is obtained as:

SP = [(100 + %Profit)/100] × CP ----(ii)

**Calculation:**

Let the CP of the item be Rs.x

So, for a loss of 33%, the SP becomes:

SP = [(100 – 33)/100] × x = 0.67x ----(iii) 

Similarly, 

for a profit of 7%, the SP becomes:

SP = [(100 + 7)/100] × x = 1.07x ----(iv) 

Now, the difference between these two selling prices = Rs.220

Hence, using equations (iii) and (iv), we get:

1.07x – 0.67x = 220

⇒ 0.4x = 220

⇒ x = 550

**∴ The Cost Price of the item is Rs.550**
